research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: DoorDash is researching systems for improving last-mile delivery of real-time, on-demand orders for perishable goods, as described in Hybrid autonomy system for autonomous and automated delivery vehicle and Automated vehicle for autonomous last-mile deliveries. Efforts also include Optimized order fulfillment from multiple sources, which uses machine learning to allocate orders, and System and Method for Dynamic Pairing Function Optimization, focusing on pairing orders with couriers. These areas highlight advancements in autonomous delivery, order optimization, and courier assignment.

overview_description.description: Doordash provides restaurant food delivery services connecting customers with local businesses. The company is passionate about transforming local businesses and is dedicated to enabling new ways of working, earning, and living. By building the last-mile delivery infrastructure for local cities  Doordash is bringing communities closer. It connects customers with their favorite local and national restaurants and Fang, Evan Moore, Stanley Tang, and Tony Xu launched the company as PaloAltoDelivery.com in 2013, which became DoorDash, Inc. in October 2014.
